title: Himachal Pradesh State Illness Assistance Fund Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government financial assistance mechanism for eligible poor patients needing treatment for specified serious diseases.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on current state income, disease and treatment criteria.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Himachal Pradesh State Illness Assistance Fund.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
